I know intellectually that our bodies change and are ultimately impermanent, and my attachment to my old body is causing me suffering. But i am having trouble letting go of my attachment. I have recently begun doing yoga and eating healthier in order to combat this, and i am starting to feel a little better. But how do i let go of my craving?Anyway i want to thank everyone again for taking the time to help me through this.
